verdict.rationale: PayPal's first-party Subscriptions docs cover recurring plans (fixed-interval or per-user variable pricing), free or discounted trials, and plan upgrades and downgrades, which is the core of the story. Proration on plan changes is never mentioned, so coverage is incomplete. missing for 10: documented proration behavior on upgrades/downgrades, independent or hands-on corroboration of the subscription APIs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set up recurring subscription billing with plans, trials, upgrades, and proration

citations.quote: Create plans that charge users a fixed amount at regular intervals or a variable amount based on the number of users subscribed.
Offer your subscribers free or discounted trials.
Enable subscribers to upgrade or downgrade their plans.
Create customizable PayPal subscription plans for regular billing, offering trials, upgrades, and automated payment recovery for flexible customer management.
